== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio) (Japanese)|U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625013/YAOlT0dW40aVGlElT6xPXA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673869.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>129a6796ea3f7e490c21f075a38b998b6049a153f7b6708f63935ac2796a4cea</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
